name: Euromarque Motorsport Park (Full Circuit)

career.layoutCall: Full circuit, 11 turns, 3.330 km, anticlockwise: Castrol Toyota FR Oceania, February 2024. Euromarque became Ruapuna's naming sponsor in February 2023; this is Ruapuna Park, Christchurch, not Pukekohe (research notes item 2). OSM loop: the three 'Raceway Ruapuna Park' ways (3286 m, 1.3% under), not the short connector that multiplies OSM's loops.

circuit.startFinishNote: start/finish at the point [-43.5301028, 172.479888] (approximate: the loop point beside the venue's largest OSM building (way 1302397266, 125 m long, with four more of its buildings, likely the pit and paddock complex); OSM has no start/finish node or pit lane here and no official map was checked)
